Three Square Trick

Rules:

• Normal sudoku rules apply.

• Along a green line, adjacent digits must have a difference of at least 5.

• Digits within a cage must add up to the total given in that cage’s upper-left corner.

• A white dot separates two digits that are consecutive.

• An X separates two digits that add to 10 and a V separates two digits that add to 5.

• Not all possible dots, Xs and Vs are given.

• In addition to the nine standard 3×3 boxes, the grid contains three hidden 3×3 regions. Each is a magic square containing the digits 1–9 exactly once, with every row, column and both main diagonals summing to the same value. The additional regions may overlap one another, but none occupies the same position as a standard box.
